_comment: [EN] Test vectors of the animation source and its '#' options, from the HarmonyOS parser (cylanimateditem/src/main/ets/CYLAnimatedItemSource.ts and its test). Every platform's parser test reads this file; add a vector here, not in one platform. [CN] 动画来源与 '#' 选项的测试向量，取自鸿蒙解析器。每个平台的解析测试都读取本文件；新增向量写在这里，不要只写在某个平台里。
rules: Options follow the first '#' or '?'; pairs are split at '&', and at a '#' or '?' that does not follow '='.
Names and values are percent-decoded; an undecodable text is kept as it is.
A pair without a name (no '=' or '=' first) is dropped.
The type comes from the file extension; inline text that starts with '{' is Lottie JSON.
